lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mo6O12 (reduced formula MoO2) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P-1 (No. 119), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mo centers coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside tetrahedral and five-vertex Mo environments; the O centers show 4-, 5-, and 6-neighbor Mo coordination. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include edge-sharing between Mo octahedra and corner-sharing between Mo octahedra and Mo tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 18 sites.
